title: Corrigendum to "A Characterization of the Unit Group in Z[T x C_2]"
summary: We correct Lemma 3.6 and Theorem 3.7 of T.~Bilgin, O.~Kusmus, and R.~M.~Low, \emph{A Characterization of the Unit Group in $\mathbb Z[T\times C_2]$}, Bull.\ Korean Math.\ Soc.\ \textbf{53} (2016), no. 4, 1105-1112. In particular, the corrected statement of Theorem 3.7 is that $U_1\bigl(\Z[T\times C_2]\bigr) \cong [F_{33}\rtimes F_5]\rtimes[T\times C_2]. $
